name: LiveEventRunOfShow
tagline: Rundown, show-caller clock and department cues for live events and broadcasts – one plug-and-play Power Platform app.
description: A complete run-of-show app: second-accurate running and back-times, an over/under clock against the hard out, a live show-caller console with one-key Next, cue sheets per department, a to-scale timeline, a readiness dashboard and a validated segment form – with demo data, low-code column mapping and Power Fx events.
features: Running time engine: start time per segment from the show start, actual durations of done segments and the live elapsed time; back-time (latest start that still hits the hard out) per segment, late starts flagged red.
Over/under clock in the header and the caller: projected end versus start + target, green (under), amber (inside tolerance), red (over).

Status workflow with business rules: Draft → Ready (needs title, duration, department) → Standby (needs at least one cue) → Live (only one at a time) → Done (actual duration captured); Dropped from Draft/Ready/Standby (never when locked), Dropped → Draft, Done → Ready to re-open.
Drop confirmation that warns when a segment is not marked floating; undo for status changes, drops, reorders, edits and bulk actions (Ctrl+Z).
Locked segments (network joins, contracted sponsor reads, ad breaks) keep their slot: they cannot move, be shifted by other moves or be dropped.
Time recovery: when the show runs over, the caller suggests the floating segments that recover the overrun.
Rule checks per segment: missing duration, missing or unknown department, cues for unknown departments, standby without cues, segments that ran over.
Bulk actions: Ready, Standby, mark floating / fixed, drop – with skips reported when rules block a segment.
Search across title, talent, cues, notes, location, type and department; filter chips; sort by running order, length, department, status or title; group by department, type or status.
Configurable show title, start time, target, tolerance, departments, segment types, 24/12-hour clock, accent and status colours and view labels – all low-code text, numbers and yes/no.
Demo mode with a fictional 26-segment awards show (Harbour Lights Music Awards 2026) so every view works the moment the control is dropped.
Phone layout with bottom view switcher, cards, a full-screen detail, a stacked caller and department cue lists; tested at 1366, 860, 375, 360 and 320 px.
Keyboard: Up/Down select, Shift+Up/Down extend, Enter opens, Alt+Up/Down moves, Delete drops, Space/N next segment in the caller, Ctrl+Z undo, Esc closes.
